Given the following forecast for SKIPPER (base year 2021):

  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "forecast": [
    {
      "year": 2022,
      "revenue_cr": 1950,
      "net_income_cr": 32,
      "eps": 3.12
    },
    {
      "year": 2023,
      "revenue_cr": 2220,
      "net_income_cr": 52,
      "eps": 5.07
    },
    {
      "year": 2024,
      "revenue_cr": 2530,
      "net_income_cr": 78,
      "eps": 7.6
    }
  ],
  "top_assumptions": [
    "Revenue growth of ~14% in FY2022 (as guided by management for double-digit growth) accelerating to ~13-14% in FY2023-24, underpinned by strong T&D capex cycle, export order momentum from China+1 trend, and Polymer segment expansion \u2014 broadly consistent with the FY2020-21 revenue CAGR but adjusted for post-pandemic recovery in margins.",
    "Net profit margin recovers gradually from the anomalously low 1.3% in FY2021 (depressed by commodity cost spikes, high freight, COVID fixed-cost absorption, and a deferred tax credit reversing in FY2020 that inflated FY2020 PAT to 3%) toward 1.6-1.7% in FY2022, 2.3% in FY2023, and 3.1% in FY2024, as interest costs continue declining (debt reduced by \u20b9152 mn in FY2021), steel/zinc price pass-through clauses normalise margins, and operating leverage kicks in on higher revenues."
  ],
  "reasoning": "FY2021 is anomalous on the PAT line: reported consolidated PAT of \u20b9214 cr (standalone \u20b9211 cr) was severely compressed by unprecedented commodity price rallies (steel, zinc, PVC resin), COVID-related fixed-cost absorption in Q1-Q2, and elevated ocean freight \u2014 while FY2020 PAT of \u20b9413 cr was itself inflated by a deferred tax credit of \u20b9233 cr (negative tax line). Revenue grew a healthy 13.7% YoY to \u20b91,582 cr (consolidated, converting \u20b915,815 mn at 1 cr = 10 mn), so the top-line trend is intact and management guided explicitly for double-digit growth in FY2022. The 3-year revenue CAGR (FY2019-FY2021 implied from quarterly data and segment history) is approximately 10-12%; blending with the latest 14% YoY and management's double-digit guidance yields ~13-14% projection. PAT forecasts assume mean-reversion in margins over FY2022-24 as interest expense continues falling (A-/Stable rating, active deleveraging), commodity pass-through normalises, and operating leverage from higher revenues accrues; the FY2020 deferred-tax windfall is treated as non-recurring. All monetary values are in INR Crores (\u20b915,815 mn = \u20b91,581.5 cr used as FY2021 base; shares outstanding ~102.67 mn = 10.267 cr shares for EPS)."
}

Step 1: Identify the 3 most critical assumptions embedded in this forecast.
Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).

RESPONSE FORMAT: Begin your response DIRECTLY with the opening brace { — no reasoning or text before the JSON.

Return ONLY valid JSON:

  "company": "<COMPANY>",
  "base_year": <YYYY>,
  "strategy": "<baseline|alt_strategy>",
  "assumptions": [
    {"assumption": "<text>", "failure_scenario": "<text>", "risk": "<Low|Medium|High>"}

  "confidence_score": <0-100>,
  "overall_critique": "<2 sentences>"
}
